answer: Price each new identity in unpredictable latency puzzles: at a random moment every epoch, all agents must answer a short reasoning question within 20 seconds. One honest agent answers once. A farm of 500 keys must run 500 live inferences in the same nebula of seconds, so its compute bill scales linearly with clones and can't be batched later. Like saffron, real presence is costly to fake; velvet promises from idle keys earn nothing.
